stepTitle:
A sine function crosses the y-axis at $$y= rac{1}{2}$$. Its maximum value is $$2$$, and its minimum value is $$-1$$. It attains its maximum at $$x= rac{\pi}{8}$$ and its minimum at $$x= rac{-\pi}{8}$$. 
 
 The function shown is of the form $$y=A\sin(Bx)+D.$$ 
 
 Identify the vertical shift $$D.$$
